title: Turbo Cleave vs Jungle
summary: Your Enhancement Shaman holds two answers — the fewest of anyone on the floor. Kill the Feral before that becomes the story.

sections.title: You are the thin team, so go early
sections.body: Counts, yours: Warrior 8, Resto 3, Enhancement 2. Theirs: Hunter 6, Priest 5, Feral 4. Your Enhancement Shaman holds Astral Shift and a trinket and nothing else, and both Shamans share a 90s Astral Shift as their only real mitigation. You cannot win a long one. The Feral is their thinnest and the only one you can reach on a 30s cadence.

sections.title: Opener — Capacitor is the term, everything aligns to it

steps.note: 40s and it is telegraphed. Drop it before you commit.
17s root, lands as the totem goes off.
On the Priest. 15s cooldown, so it repeats inside one go.
90s. Your slowest term — the cadence is this, not the totem.
60s. Align it to Avatar or you get half a go.
On the Feral, after the Capacitor stun has fallen off DR.
30s. The filler term between full goes.

sections.title: What the Feral answers with — only four

steps.note: 36s. Up every go — not worth forcing.

sections.title: What punishes you for being slow

steps.note: 25s. The cheapest control on the floor.
30s, and both your Shamans are melee-range.
Free. Two Shamans with three answers between them.
